column_description: TEXT. Account reference. PK. FK to accounts.
TEXT. Masked handle of the user. Possible values: Natural, Random, Sequential, Template.
BIGINT. Length of the username. Example: 13.
TEXT. User pattern description. Possible values: AlphaNum, Generated, Meaningful, Random.
BIGINT. Displacement change value. **NULL means displacement change not recorded.**. Example: 8.0.
TEXT. Picture format. **NULL means picture format not specified.**. Possible values: AI Generated, Celebrity, Real, Stock.
BIGINT. Length of bio information. Example: 118.0.
TEXT. Bio language type. Possible values: en, mixed, multiple, unknown.
BIGINT. Number of bio links. Possible values: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.
TEXT. Bio keyword hits. **NULL means bio keyword hits not counted.**. Possible values: Normal, Promo, Spam, Suspicious.
TEXT. Location flag status. Possible values: Fake, Multiple, No, Yes.
TEXT. Email domain. Possible values: Custom, Disposable, Free, Unknown.
TEXT. Telephone state. **NULL means telephone state not recorded.**. Possible values: Invalid, VOIP, Valid.
